project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-170 Code Canvas: Claude Agent SDK Embed (Remediation Chain net-new track)
description: Branch from main after PRD-156 merges. BINDING D3: headless Claude Agent SDK session per workspace runs in the worker container; the platform UI renders the session — file tree, streaming turns, diff approvals, commit/push. SUBSTRATE EXISTS, reuse it: workspace_read_file/write_file/list_dir/grep/exec/git tools (modules/tools/discovery/workspace_actions.py:19-341) + worker-container file/exec API (api/workspace_files.py, mounted main.py:1023). Q85: workspace_files POST /exec is the one exec surface (unmounted workspace_exec.py router DELETED). Q38/Q41: codegraph indexes the workspace clone. D11: session token budgets surfaced in UI. Full spec docs/PRDS/PRD-170-CODE-CANVAS-AGENT-SDK.md.

userStories.title: SDK session service in the worker container
userStories.description: Session manager: start/resume/stop a headless claude (Agent SDK) session per workspace; transcript + state persist on the worker volume (sessions survive orchestrator restarts); platform proxy POST /api/workspaces/{id}/canvas/sessions with RequestContext auth; one active session per workspace v1; session cannot escape its workspace mount.
acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle integration test against a seeded workspace container
Resume-after-restart test (state on volume)
Path-escape attempt blocked (tenancy test)
cd orchestrator && pytest -q green

userStories.title: Worker provisioning for wizard workspaces
userStories.description: Wizard-created workspaces have NO worker container (workspace_files.py:33-47 DB-fallback note). Provision-on-demand at first canvas open (default: per-workspace container for isolation; a shared sandboxed runner needs a decision memo in the PR if chosen instead); honest provisioning progress + failure states in UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard workspace → open canvas → working session (e2e)
Provisioning failure shows honest error + retry — verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Diff approval loop
userStories.description: SDK permission prompts map to UI approval cards; file edits render as diffs (in-bundle diff viewer preferred — any new heavy dep needs an S1-style memo); approve applies / deny reverts and informs the session; per-turn auto-accept toggle (session-scoped, default OFF, visibly indicated).
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal → diff card → approve applies / deny reverts+informs (e2e both paths)
Auto-accept toggle honored + indicated — verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.description: Default branch canvas/<session-id>; commit from UI with generated editable message; push via the EXISTING workspace_git tool using GitHub App installation tokens (PRD-165 base) and platform actor identity (PRD-168 pattern); PR-open link-out v1. No token material in logs/errors (PRD-154 S12 test class re-applied).

Token-leak negative tests green
